verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a SaaS code-review agent, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no API keys, tokens, or least-privilege credential issuance. The only related item is the GitHub app's choice between all repositories and selected repositories, which scopes the integration's repo access rather than issuing agent credentials, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
